Subject: Quick heads-up: vendor bakeoff & perf targets for renewal

Sean —

We're kicking off a formal bakeoff next week as part of our renewal review. We have NovaServe and two other vendors running against a set of latency/throughput tests across our priority inference workloads (session-based chat, 8k window; and batch embeddings).

Can Redwood provide (by 2026-12-10):
- a short, runnable benchmark plan we can run on our infra (step-by-step)
- perf targets (p95 latency for 1,2,4 concurrent streams; tokens/sec for batch)
- any notes on quantization/format constraints or hardware recommendations

Procurement is pushing for numbers they can compare side-by-side. We're also expecting commercial proposals after testing. If there's any way you can provide a hosted test or run a quick workshop, that would help.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call this week if useful.

Claire Ng
Head of ML Ops, OliveTech
claire@olivetech.ai

Sean / Marissa —

Draft benchmark plan attached (olivetech-benchmark-plan.pdf) and a raw performance matrix (redwood-performance-matrix.csv). High-level notes:

- Workloads covered: interactive chat (8k window, single-stream p95 targets) and batch embeddings (2560 tokens/batch).
- Test modes: 1) customer-run (playbook + sample payloads) 2) Redwood-hosted controlled run (we can provision a Dedicated pool for 48 hours to mirror their target GPUs).
- Key knobs: sequence length, kv-cache priming, batching factor, quantization (int8 vs fp16). Our CSV includes baseline numbers for a 4x A100 pool and an 8x H100 pool so they can see delta.
- Measurement: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, memory utilization. We'll provide a small script to output the same CSV schema so results are comparable.

Questions/asks:
- Customer must run a canonical dataset (I included a small sample set in the drive link).
- If they want dedicated-hosted run, we need signoff on an NDA amendment and a short SOW for access.

I'll be available for a 45m technical walkthrough next Tue (12/8) to walk their infra team through the playbook.

Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Thanks Vanessa, plan looks good. Drafted a commercial play to pair with the technical offer (see draft-term-amendment.docx):

- Offer: 6-month capacity uplift (20% above current committed baseline) at a 12% discount to list for the uplift portion; one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the uplift value applied to invoices.

- Migration/Support: 2 dedicated onboarding days (engineer + SE) and a runbook handoff.

I also attached a one-page exec summary we can send to Claire to make the ask concise. Procurement will still push for price parity with NovaServe, but this gives us a mix of performance commitment + short-term commercial relief.

Please review the doc and the one-pager. If we have a Redwood-hosted run, I'll attach the SOW and a DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole

2) If we choose Redwood on the back of this test, can you commit to a named onboarding engineer and an accelerated migration SLA (2-week targeted cutover window, with an outage mitigation plan)?

Procurement expects a final commercial position by 2026-12-15. If you can provide the perf guarantee + the commit on migration support, we will include that alongside the test results when we score vendors.

Claire

Claire / OliveTech procurement team —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sharing NovaServe's offer. We value OliveTech as a strategic partner and want to make the decision simple. Below is our coordinated position based on Vanessa's tests and Marissa's commercial construct.

1) Performance guarantee
- We will provide a Redwood-hosted controlled run (48-hour window) that replicates your target GPU profile. Vanessa's team will run the canonical script and deliver p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec in the same CSV schema.
- Commitment: p95 <= 220ms for the 8k window interactive workload (single-stream baseline) when running on an 8x H100-equivalent pool, measured during the controlled run and validated against the provided canonical dataset. If we miss the commitment by >10% on p95, Redwood will provide a one-time invoice credit equal to 5% of the monthly uplift spend.

2) Migration & onboarding commitment
- Named team: Lead SE — Vanessa Ortiz; Lead Engineer — Tom Erickson (cc'd internally on the SOW; contact will be provided after SOW sign-off).
- SLA: We will target a 2-week cutover window for the uplift migration with a formal outage mitigation checklist and a rollback plan. This will be captured in the SOW.

3) Commercial offer
- 6-month uplift at 20% above current baseline, uplift priced at 12% off list. One-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of uplift value.
- If OliveTech converts uplift into a 12-month commit within 30 days after the uplift period, we will extend the discount for the first renewal quarter.

4) Next steps & links
- Vanessa: schedule the Redwood-hosted run for 12/20–12/22 (48h window).
- Marissa: please attach the SOW & DocuSign link.
- Claire / Procurement: if you accept this position, we'll move the SOW through DocuSign and spin up the test infra.

I attached the performance matrix and the draft term amendment; DocuSign link is included in related links. We're available for a 30m exec sync this week if you'd like to walk the guarantees live.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
